content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AMU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Guest Teacher-Mathematics recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the AMU Guest Teacher-Mathematics positions is 23 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Teacher-Mathematics post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Guest Teacher-Mathematics position announced by Aligarh Muslim University under the recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in Mathematics or an allied subject, along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Teacher-Mathematics role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Teacher-Mathematics position ranges from Rs. 1500/- per lecture to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month, depending on the number of lectures and other factors.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 500/-. SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the AMU Guest Teacher-Mathematics recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Teacher-Mathematics post primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the AMU Guest Teacher-Mathematics recruitment must be submitted online through the official website of Aligarh Muslim University.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Guest Teacher-Mathematics position at Aligarh Muslim University is on a contractual basis.
